purpose: Portable collection-task design and bounded evidence ledger; no raw diagnostics or complete product/conformance claim.
review_scope: Collection draft continuity and collapsed source-stage discoverability only; source and rendered-state heuristic review, not human usability research.

guideline_policy.synthesis_limit: Draft ownership, independent persistence, identity hints and the verification matrix are project decisions, not verbatim source requirements.

records.summary: Collection authoring had no contextual source acquisition entry. Saving or explicitly discarding, visiting Sources and reopening remained possible; a continuity gap, not a dead end.
records.observation_limit: The reviewed empty editor screenshot had zero selected sources, not proven zero inventory; the no-available-source branch was source-confirmed.
required_invariants: Return to the owning unsaved collection with its name, ordered source references, per-source steps and post-merge steps preserved.
One visible task; actual dirty and pending state govern cancellation and navigation.

HTTP save failure retains the Source subtask inputs and error for retry or cancellation while preserving the hidden parent collection draft; it does not automatically return to the collection or claim persistence.
A successfully saved usable Source is independently persisted and appended only to the collection draft.
No implicit Collection or Profile save, source-candidate acceptance, subscription publication or update.
Discarding the collection does not undo an independently saved Source.

A successful save response containing a candidate, diagnostic, failed-status or last-error returns to the collection with an honest saved-source notice and actual recovery; the source remains unselected. This is distinct from HTTP save failure.
Diagnostic recovery navigates to the existing Sources page through the leave guard; canceling navigation retains the collection draft. This is not full inline recovery.
Return focus belongs to the originating source trigger after animation; late results cannot revive a replaced task.

records.summary: Collapsed source rows showed identity and order but concealed source-processing purpose and configured-step state until expanded.
required_invariants: Collapsed rows identify source processing and show a nonzero configured-step count.
The configured count includes disabled steps and is not an execution or applied-state claim.
Source identity, order, keyboard disclosure and reorder controls remain usable.
Expanding or collapsing does not change values; reordering keeps source-specific steps with the same source.
Post-merge processing remains separate and available, including prepared zero-source and one-source recipes.

candidate_regressions.affected_version: Initial contextual-source candidate, not the original product baseline
candidate_regressions.summary: A successful source save could return to a draft without its friendly source name while authoritative list refetch was pending or failed.
candidate_regressions.correction: Current-draft-only stable ID and name hints preserve known identity without copying connection content, changing query status or claiming freshness. The authoritative list name takes precedence after recovery; removal and a new collection opening retire the hint.
candidate_regressions.verification_scope: Focused public-DOM regression covers pending, failed and renamed authoritative refetch, removal and new-opening isolation. Final real-backend POST with synthetic GET failure proves immediate friendly identity; terminal list-error presentation remains separately DOM-covered.

candidate_regressions.affected_version: Initial contextual-source diagnostic UI candidate, not the original product baseline
candidate_regressions.summary: At 320 px the diagnostic text was compressed by a side-by-side recovery action, despite functional browser passes.
candidate_regressions.correction: Scoped narrow-layout stacking of diagnostic content and action, without adding explanatory copy.
candidate_regressions.verification_scope: Final integrated 320 px candidate and diagnostic screenshots and browser geometry confirm stacked action and readable message; not all-state or all-device acceptance.

verification_history.summary: Earlier candidate passed its focused and browser tasks but preceded the identity-refetch and diagnostic-width corrections.
verification_history.limitation: Not final acceptance; its counts are not added to subsequent runs.

verification_history.summary: An early fixture expectation omitted the backend-normalized override object. Correcting the expectation does not establish a product defect.

failure_classification.summary: Reopening a saved collection timed out while the helper awaited animation completion across the whole subtree.
A later empty-state assertion encountered a collection left by a prior failed task.
A later source-list task could not find the newly added source.

verification_history.limitation: Original failed invocation preserved. Fresh full rerun passes without production changes; the original timeout direct cause and later missing-source failure cause remain unproven, not rewritten as a proven spinner fix. Diagnostic/probe counts are not pooled.

fixture_correction.animation_wait: Added actual Drawer motion ancestor while preserving running-subtree checks and the original five-second failure boundary.
fixture_correction.isolation: Exact-object cleanup after each task; a deliberate failure followed by an independent check validated cleanup.
fixture_correction.limitation: Observed helper coverage and cleanup gaps are not proof of the initial timeout cause or the later missing-source failure cause.

final_verification.source_manifest_scope: 585 source/config/test files after the browser-only fixture correction; original full Web input manifests and the unchanged-input reuse bridge remain separately recorded.

source.scope: Source, configuration and test inputs for this invocation; excludes unrelated documentation and generated artifacts.

extended.scope: Standard scope plus direct ticket-check documentary inputs, repository instructions and relevant root formatting/configuration inputs.

runs.limitation: Not an aggregate all-gates pass. CT-EV-05 separately supports reuse after a browser-spec-only correction; the original 585/614-file manifests remain historical.
The original full-run manifests remain historical. This bounded input comparison supports nonbrowser evidence reuse, not browser acceptance or a general JavaScript effect proof.

runs.summary: Independent complete run of 48 tasks, not prior passes plus diagnostic subsets. Creation returns to the owning unsaved collection, independent Source persistence and explicit Collection save/reopen preserve order and both stages; normal focus returns after motion.
runs.synthetic_fault_scope: Candidate/diagnostic branches alter response state after real Source persistence, not actual importer-generated candidates. Save 503 and post-save list-GET failure are explicitly synthetic HTTP faults.
runs.limitation: Selected local Chromium tasks and viewports, not external clients, production or human understanding. Browser immediate-name evidence does not newly certify terminal list-error recovery.
Local synthetic read-only containment and source synchronization, not real authentication, successful backend save, publication, deployment or traffic enforcement.

reviewed_views: Rich returned collection draft at 1280, 390 and 320 px
Candidate and diagnostic warning at 320 px
visual_review.summary: Source identity, ordered stages, configured counts and natural keyboard focus remain readable. Narrow recovery actions stack under the message; 320 px uses ordinary vertical scrolling without observed overlap or horizontal overflow.
visual_review.limitation: Selected actual synthetic business states only; inventory is not an all-screenshots-reviewed claim, and heuristic review is not human usability research.

overall_seven_dimension_readiness.judgment: No still-confirmed high-impact UX/model gap requiring another autonomous design round was established. Final bounded checks are complete; primary flows are reasonably mature for holistic user acceptance, with stated evidence limits and residual risks retained.
retained_risks: Abnormal import recovery remains guarded navigation to Sources, not inline acceptance.
In some unowned-history scenarios, canceling navigation may require a new current entry that truncates Forward history; this tradeoff is disclosed.
A historical logout did not reach its login-title assertion in time; its cause remains unproven and is not closed by later passing runs.
overall_seven_dimension_readiness.limitation: Representative heuristic review, not human usability acceptance, complete accessibility, all-device or native acceptance. Historical and current versions remain separately identified; test counts do not by themselves establish maturity.

limitations: Historical content-round, previous preview and superseded candidate passes do not sign off this round or its final combination.
A saved Source with unresolved diagnostics is not automatically accepted, selected or usable; recovery still requires guarded navigation to the existing Sources page.
Known source identity can be retained while list freshness remains unknown; this is not permission to synthesize current health or loading success.
Focused DOM, actual backend tasks, selected pixel review and human comprehension research establish different conclusions.
No Google certification, complete WCAG conformance, complete native-runtime acceptance, production deployment or applied traffic is claimed.
Completing CT-01/02 does not by itself establish readiness across all seven product-maturity dimensions.
Absent Git metadata still blocks the tracked-private guard and unmodified aggregate gate; managed-runtime offline dependencies and native/opt-in skips remain outside passing evidence.
Existing large-chunk, component deprecation and JSDOM capability advisories are not newly resolved by this round.
